One prompt

$ orcacode -p "Summarize the test failures"
$ orcacode --json -p "List changed files"
$ orcacode --plan -p "Propose a migration plan"
$ orcacode --auto -p "Run the focused tests and fix failures"

-p / --prompt supplies the request. Add --json to emit NDJSON harness events to stdout for a program to consume.

Automation and approvals

Headless runs default to Auto: safe tools proceed and every unresolved exact action is reviewed against the root request. Use --normal to request ordinary approval policy. Bare --auto-approve retains the legacy normal-mode path and permits shell, write, and edit calls without model review; --yolo implies it. If explicit --auto is present, Auto review still governs unresolved actions. Use --plan when the job should inspect and propose only.

SCRIPTING TIP

Pass --workspace explicitly in automation rather than relying on the caller’s current directory. Add --no-session for ephemeral jobs that should not write session history.
